title: 24-Layer Stack with Latin Hypercube Sampling and Expanded Bounds
scientific_hypothesis: Increasing layer count to 24 while using stratified Latin Hypercube Sampling initialization across ±25% quarter-wave bounds will access previously unexplored optical path length combinations, enabling better dual-band spectral separation than the 12L baseline (0.7448) and avoiding the 16L regression (0.5170).
design_principle: Global surrogate-model exploration with LHS initialization provides broader coverage of the thickness design space before local refinement, reducing risk of convergence to poor local minima that caused the 16L score regression.
proposed_topology: Air | [HfO2 | SiO2] × 12 | Fused Silica substrate; exactly 24 finite layers in alternating sequence starting with HfO2
design_variables: Optimizer initialization via stratified Latin Hypercube Sampling
soft_objectives: Maximize average transmittance in 1000-1700 nm band
Maximize average reflectance in 300-450 nm band
manufacturing_considerations: Total layer count 24 remains within 30-layer constraint
Thickness bounds ±25% of quarter-wave medians (HfO2: 155 nm ±25%, SiO2: 230 nm ±25%)
theory_basis: Transfer matrix method for plane-wave propagation through layered media
Latin Hypercube Sampling for stratified design space coverage
expected_advantages: Broader exploration of thickness combinations than gradient-only initialization
24 layers provide more degrees of freedom for dual-band optimization than 12L or 16L
±25% bounds balance exploration with fabrication realism
known_risks: Higher layer count increases optimization complexity and computation time
May still converge to local minima if surrogate model underexplores
Performance may not exceed 12L baseline if additional layers introduce parasitic interference
execution_request_english: Design and optimize a 24-layer planar dielectric stack on fused silica substrate with air incidence. Stack sequence: Air | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | Fused Silica (exactly 24 finite layers, alternating starting with HfO2). Initialize all 24 layer thicknesses using stratified Latin Hypercube Sampling across bounds: HfO2 layers 116.25-193.75 nm (155 nm ±25%), SiO2 layers 172.5-287.5 nm (230 nm ±25%). Use global surrogate-model optimizer prioritizing exploration over local refinement until best_target_score exceeds 0.7500. Evaluate normal-incidence unpolarized plane-wave illumination. Spectral range 300-1700 nm. Objective: maximize transmittance in 1000-1700 nm band, maximize reflectance in 300-450 nm band. Total layer count constraint: exactly 24 layers (within 30-layer limit). Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 300-450 nm, 1000-1700 nm. soft objectives: high transmission in 1000-1700 nm; high reflection in 300-450 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: reflection in 1000-1700 nm; transmission in 300-450 nm. manufacturing constraints: total layer count <= 30.
revision_reason: Round 4 refinement per feedback directives: increased layer count to 24, implemented LHS initialization, reverted to ±25% thickness bounds, prioritized global exploration over local gradient refinement to address 16L score regression.
